description: Fetch one web page and return its main content as Markdown, rotating across extraction providers (Jina Reader, Firecrawl, Parallel, Tavily, Exa) with failover. Use it to read a URL the user or a previous search_web result already names; it does not discover links or crawl a site. Only http and https URLs are accepted. The result names the provider that succeeded, lists failed attempts and truncates content beyond 50,000 characters with a marker; if every provider fails, the tool returns an error listing each provider's reason.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to fetch, including scheme and host

name: fetch_url
title: Fetch URL
